title: A tier kept only by an invoiced work order can be deleted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with one labor line and no parts, invoiced.
  • Have customer A put back on Default.
  • Have a part ready to add with a cost of $100.00 in a category whose Default prices it at a known price (for example $135.00).
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  3. Click Delete.
  4. Click Delete in the dialog.
  5. Open work order 1's invoice.
  6. Reverse the invoice.
  7. Add the part to work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Delete can be clicked (not grayed).
  • No open work order keeps tier A, so nothing blocks it.

Step 3:

  • The Delete question opens.

Step 4:

  • Tier A is deleted.

Step 5:

  • The invoice opens.

Step 6:

  • Work order 1 is back in status Complete.

Step 7:

  • The part is priced at the Default price, $135.00 = Default's $135.00, and its price details name Default.
